<!--
  PHOTOGRAPHY MAP
  Content comes from data/places.json, which scripts/build_photos.py generates
  from photos-inbox/. You shouldn't need to edit this file to add photos.
-->

::: {.column-screen}
```{=html}
<section class="pm-wrap">
  <div id="pm-map" aria-label="Map of photo locations"></div>

  <div class="pm-panel">
    <div class="eyebrow">Field notes</div>
    <h1 class="pm-title">Photography</h1>
    <p class="pm-intro">Landscapes, field sites, and places that shaped how I see land and water.
      Click a circle to open the gallery.</p>
    <div class="pm-legend">
      <span><i class="field"></i>Fieldwork</span>
      <span><i class="nature"></i>Nature</span>
      <span><i class="travel"></i>Travel</span>
    </div>
    <ol class="pm-list" id="pm-list"></ol>
    <p class="pm-sample" id="pm-sample" hidden><i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i> Sample images shown. Real photos coming soon.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- Carousel modal -->
<div class="pm-modal" id="pm-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="pm-m-title" hidden>
  <div class="pm-m-head">
    <div>
      <div class="pm-m-region" id="pm-m-region"></div>
      <h2 class="pm-m-title" id="pm-m-title"></h2>
    </div>
    <button class="pm-btn pm-close" id="pm-close" aria-label="Close gallery"><i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i></button>
  </div>
  <div class="pm-stage">
    <button class="pm-btn pm-prev" id="pm-prev" aria-label="Previous photo"><i class="bi bi-chevron-left"></i></button>
    <div class="pm-figure">
      <img id="pm-img" alt="">
      <div class="pm-caption"><span id="pm-cap"></span><span class="pm-count" id="pm-count"></span></div>
    </div>
    <button class="pm-btn pm-next" id="pm-next" aria-label="Next photo"><i class="bi bi-chevron-right"></i></button>
  </div>
  <p class="pm-m-blurb" id="pm-m-blurb"></p>
  <div class="pm-thumbs" id="pm-thumbs"></div>
</div>

<script src="assets/photo-map.js"></script>
```
:::
